mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a drop in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (indicating supply chain disruption) leads to reduced corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending trend (as measured by RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a severe labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
